column1: # Danish (da). Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05, pending the three-vendor debate; not final. status stays draft. See l10n/README.md for each field.
# percent_style has a no-break space (U+00A0) between the number and the sign, never U+202F, which Saira lacks. decimal_style is an example of the separators; Danish groups thousands with a period.
